sections.introduction: Vayu Gutika (Vati) is an ayurvedic formulation that is formulated with a mixture of fruitful herbs. This formulation is also known to contain minerals.
sections.ingredients:
Hiravi – Mallotus philippensis 
 Pasupasi – Myristica fragrans 
 Trijata – Cinnamon, Cardamom and Cinnamon leaf 
 Trikatu – Pepper, long pepper and ginger 
 Purified Karpura – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Ponkaram – Borax Aconitum ferox 
 Kasturi – Musk 
 Jatiphala – Myristica fragrans 
 Karimpuvu – Syzygium aromaticum 
 Jiraka – Cuminum cyminum 
 Agragrahi – Anacyclus pyrethrum 
 Chaliyam – Purified Cinnabar 
 Vacha – Acorus calamus 
 Anjana – Berberis aristata

sections.rasa_purified_and_processed_mercury:
Rasna – Vanda roxburghii 
 Madhuka – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Chinnamulukum – Sital Chini 
 Dipyaka – Trachyspermum roxburghianum 
 Manyolyum – Purified and processed Copper pyrite 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the equal quantity of all the ingredients and powder them. 
 Now ground all the ingredients with rose water and Bhringraj swarasa, also known as juice of eclipta alba. 
 Now take the quantity of 250 mg and make its pills. 

 Medicinal Properties 
 Vayu Gutika is very useful Ayurvedic formulation that helps to maintain the Vata and Pitta dosha balance, effective in various body ailments. 
 It has beneficial effects in respiratory conditions. It is effective in bronchitis, reduces the inflammation in bronchioles and easily expectorate the phlegm, thereby simplifying the pathway of breathing. Provides relief from cold and controls cough. It is useful in asthma too, helps in proper breathing and prevents its recurrence. It is suitable for fever, regulate the body temperature. 
 It is also useful in gastric conditions. Improves digestion and hence strengthens the digestive power. It benefits to enhance appetite, in case there is loss of appetite. Relieves the condition of abdominal distention and provides relief from abdominal cramps, bloating and pain. It is able to control the vomiting and relieves the discomfort. Provides relief from hiccups. 
 It has the property to act as a fine stimulant in fatigue, coma, and faintness.

sections.contraindications:
Take under medical prescription, especially those males who are taking infertility treatment.

Vayu Gutika (Vati) 
 Reference – Sahasrayogam Gutika Prakarana 67. 
 Introduction 
 Vayu Gutika (Vati) is an ayurvedic formulation that is formulated with a mixture of fruitful herbs. This formulation is also known to contain minerals. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Hiravi – Mallotus philippensis 
 Pasupasi – Myristica fragrans 
 Trijata – Cinnamon, Cardamom and Cinnamon leaf 
 Trikatu – Pepper, long pepper and ginger 
 Purified Karpura – Cinnamomum camphora 
 Ponkaram – Borax Aconitum ferox 
 Kasturi – Musk 
 Jatiphala – Myristica fragrans 
 Karimpuvu – Syzygium aromaticum 
 Jiraka – Cuminum cyminum 
 Agragrahi – Anacyclus pyrethrum 
 Chaliyam – Purified Cinnabar 
 Vacha – Acorus calamus 
 Anjana – Berberis aristata 
 Krishna Jeeraka – Nigella sativ a 
 Satakuppayum – Anethum graveolens 
 Iruveli – Coleus amboinicus 
 Kantha – Iron Bhasma 
 Ksharadwaya – Yavakshara 
 Rasa – Purified and processed Mercury 
 Rasna – Vanda roxburghii 
 Madhuka – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Chinnamulukum – Sital Chini 
 Dipyaka – Trachyspermum roxburghianum 
 Manyolyum – Purified and processed Copper pyrite 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the equal quantity of all the ingredients and powder them. 
 Now ground all the ingredients with rose water and Bhringraj swarasa, also known as juice of eclipta alba. 
 Now take the quantity of 250 mg and make its pills. 
 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Vayu Gutika is very useful Ayurvedic formulation that helps to maintain the Vata and Pitta dosha balance, effective in various body ailments. 
 It has beneficial effects in respiratory conditions. It is effective in bronchitis, reduces the inflammation in bronchioles and easily expectorate the phlegm, thereby simplifying the pathway of breathing. Provides relief from cold and controls cough. It is useful in asthma too, helps in proper breathing and prevents its recurrence. It is suitable for fever, regulate the body temperature. 
 It is also useful in gastric conditions. Improves digestion and hence strengthens the digestive power. It benefits to enhance appetite, in case there is loss of appetite. Relieves the condition of abdominal distention and provides relief from abdominal cramps, bloating and pain. It is able to control the vomiting and relieves the discomfort. Provides relief from hiccups. 
 It has the property to act as a fine stimulant in fatigue, coma, and faintness. 
 Indications 
 
 Indigestion 
 Abdominal pain 
 Anorexia 
 Hiccups 
 Bronchitis 
 Cold and cough 
 Epilepsy 
 Nerve disorders 
 Asthma 
 
 Dosage 
 One to two tablets, one to two times a day, after meals.

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
